criteria.description: [R1] `from app_int.main import multiply` succeeds and `multiply` is callable.
[R2] `multiply` takes exactly two positional parameters named `a` and `b` (as reported by `inspect.signature`).
[R5] `multiply` has a non-empty docstring and its signature is annotated with `int` for `a`, `b`, and the return type.
[R6] A test function in `tests/` imports `multiply` from `app_int.main` and asserts on its return value; that test is collected and passes under `uv run pytest -q`.
[R7] `health_check()` still returns `{"status": "ok"}`, `add(2, 3)` still returns `5`, and the pre-existing tests `test_health_check_reports_ok` and `test_add_returns_the_sum` still pass.
[R8] `uv run ruff check .` exits with status 0.
